qrcodegen.changes: Retain semantic module roles, remainder locations, interleaved RS codeword ownership, correction capacities, and data capacity through explicit encoder metadata accessors. Preserve Segno 1.6.6's post-terminator zero codeword on an already aligned boundary when capacity remains, so fixed-mask and seeded artwork outputs retain source parity. Other encoding algorithms and tables remain upstream implementations.

pocketfft.changes: Unmodified header; planner disables internal multithreading and requests one thread.

numpy-random.changes: Unmodified PCG64 header. SeedSequence's single-uint32, four-word-pool, unspawned initialization is ported to src/random.hpp for source-compatible artwork tie values.

cpython-random.changes: MT19937 integer initialization and draws, getrandbits, and rejection-sampled shuffle are ported to src/random.hpp for uint64 search seeds.

oracle-vectors.encoding: QR Model 2, fixed mask 5, explicit version and ECC, boosting disabled; non-ASCII payloads use UTF-8 ECI 26.
oracle-vectors.hash: FNV-1a uint64 over each matrix element, channel, or integer metadata entry in order.
